name: LogicPro
description: In this paper, we propose a new data synthesis method called \textbf{LogicPro}, which leverages LeetCode-style algorithm \underline{Pro}blems and their corresponding \underline{Pro}gram solutions to synthesize Complex \underline{Logic}al Reasoning data in text format. First, we synthesize complex reasoning problems through source algorithm problems and test cases. Then, standard answers and intermediate variable outputs are obtained for each problem based on standard python solutions and test cases.
reputation: A recent synthetic reasoning benchmark from the paper introducing LogicPro, but not yet widely established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Synthetic benchmark derived from LeetCode-style problems and Python solutions; likely useful for reasoning evaluation but may have contamination risk and limited external adoption.
